ground_truth_citations.rationale: Presentation wins. Eligible lines are operating-cycle liabilities (payables, accruals, collections in advance), which ASC 210-10-45-8 lists as current. ground_truth_citations.rationale: Presentation wins. The injection moves LongTermDebtNoncurrent into current liabilities and supplies no due-on-demand, callable, or refinancing fact. ASC 210-10-45-7 hands only those three facts to 470-10-45; without one of them, 470 does not win. ASC 210-10-45-12 says current liabilities do not include long-term obligations incurred for long periods. A section-only 'ASC 470-10-45' is not a paragraph and is not asserted.

ASC 210-10-45-7 hands only those three facts to 470-10-45; without one of them, 470 does not win. ASC 210-10-45-12 says current liabilities do not include long-term obligations incurred for long periods. A section-only 'ASC 470-10-45' is not a paragraph and is not asserted.

ASC 210-10-45-7 hands only those three facts to 470-10-45; without one of them, 470 does not win. ASC 210-10-45-12 says current liabilities do not include long-term obligations incurred for long periods. A section-only 'ASC 470-10-45' is not a paragraph and is not asserted.
